verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs say users can upload documents, spreadsheets, photos and videos to get answers, summaries and insights about that content. Connected Apps summarize Gmail and search across productivity apps, Deep Research can draw on personal Gmail and Drive, and the Daily Brief proactively delivers personalized priorities. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specific to the consumer app's insights on user data (the community reports on meeting-notes and PDF analysis do not clearly involve this app).
